reason: In CredentialHelper.createRecoveryCodesCredential (patch lines 60-65), local createCredential is only called when updateCredential returns false. That call is the only place old stored recovery codes get deleted (RecoveryAuthnCodesCredentialProvider.java:39-40). UserCredentialManager.isValid (model/storage/.../UserCredentialManager.java:66-79) falls back to the local RecoveryAuthnCodesCredentialProvider.isValid (:101), so leftover local codes still pass authentication.
